must_notice: 35% is a relative team-level period change, not 35 percentage points
Concurrent interventions prevent personal/isolated causal attribution
User owns meaningful product and experiment work even though individual uplift is unavailable
must_not_assume: A lost A/B log can be reconstructed as a verified outcome
Engineering authorship follows from acceptance work
non_blocking_unknowns: Independent authentication of the supplied dashboard
acceptable_recommendations: Keep a carefully attributed team-period metric with base values and personal scope
Omit the number if brevity cannot preserve attribution; retain real hypothesis/design/acceptance contributions
unacceptable_recommendations: Delete all product ownership as if the user only participated
action_requirements: Produce a usable rewritten bullet and 3–5 actual follow-up questions
Separate measured team change from personal action and missing isolated effect
reconsideration_requirements: An inspected isolated experiment result could support stronger personal effect wording
If base values/time window cannot be substantiated, omit the number
evidence_requirements: Separate project stage, completed product contribution and unknown individual implementation credit
expected_commitment: Strongest justified reversible or conditional recommendation; alternate supported choices allowed
boundary: No exact winner or phrase matching; no outcomes supplied. A formal contract passing does not certify semantics.
